title: From Global Benchmarks to Local Evaluations: Benchmarking LLMs for the German Public Sector
abstract: arXiv:2608.17827v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Public institutions face a persistent challenge in selecting LLMs suited to their specific context. Existing benchmarks, however, are of limited use as they primarily reflect English-language and US-centric settings, and often only evaluate task performance. In this paper, we present first results of M\"OVE, a holistic evaluation framework for the German public sector, examining three rarely considered governance dimensions: energy consumption, provider transparency, and knowledge of German-party positions. Our results reveal significant trade-offs, with no single model excelling across all dimensions: estimated energy consumption varies more than 60-fold and is not explained by model size alone, information disclosure varies systematically across providers, and European models do not exhibit stronger knowledge of German party positions. translated_title: 从全球基准到本地评估：为德国公共部门基准测试大型语言模型
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.17827v1 公告类型：新 摘要：公共机构在选择适合其特定情境的大型语言模型（LLM）方面面临持续挑战。然而，现有基准的用处有限，因为它们主要反映英语和美国中心化的设置，且往往仅评估任务性能。在本文中，我们展示了M\"OVE的首批结果，这是一个针对德国公共部门的整体评估框架，考察了三个鲜少被考虑的治理维度：能源消耗、提供商透明度以及对德国政党立场的知识。我们的结果揭示了显著的权衡取舍，没有单一模型在所有维度上表现出色：估算的能源消耗差异超过60倍，且不能仅由模型大小解释；信息披露在不同提供商之间存在系统性差异；欧洲模型并未表现出对德国政党立场的更强知识。因此，公共机构的模型选择不能仅依赖性能排名，而应基于评估。
tldr: 本文提出针对德国公共部门的整体评估框架M\"OVE，发现能源消耗、提供商透明度和政党知识三个维度上无单一模型全能，强调模型选择需超越性能排名。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces M\"OVE, a holistic evaluation framework for the German public sector, revealing trade-offs across energy consumption, provider transparency, and party-position knowledge, and argues that model selection must go beyond performance rankings.
